map.入土段长=埋深÷sin(入土角)、出土段长=埋深÷sin(出土角)；总施工长=穿: Entry section length = depth / sin(entry angle), exit section length = depth / sin(exit angle); total construction length = crossing distance + entry section + exit section; drilled length = total length + 2 x depth; reaming diameter = pipe diameter x 1.4. D<=400 is conventional, <=800 is medium, otherwise a large diameter crossing.
map.穿越距离 200m、管径 300mm、入土角 10°、出土角 8°、埋深 5m：: Crossing distance 200m, pipe diameter 300mm, entry angle 10°, exit angle 8°, depth 5m: entry section 5/sin10°=28.8m, exit section 5/sin8°=35.9m, total length 264.7m, drilled 274.7m, reaming 420mm, D=300<=400 is a conventional crossing.
map.入出土角一般取多少？: What values are usually taken for the entry and exit angles?
map.常用 8°~18°，过小钻进过长、过大曲率大易卡钻；需结合埋深与管材弯曲半径确定: Commonly 8°~18°; too small makes the drilled length excessive, too large gives a large curvature that easily sticks the drill; it must be set together with the burial depth and the pipe bend radius.
map.扩孔为什么取管径 1.4 倍？: Why is the reaming taken at 1.4 times the pipe diameter?
map.留回拖余隙与泥浆环空间，保证管道顺利回拖并减少抱管风险，大口径可适当提高。: To leave clearance for pullback and space for the mud ring, ensuring the pipe pulls back smoothly and reducing the risk of pipe binding; it can be raised appropriately for large diameters.
